content:
anja: Heads up — saw a spike in invoice-preview delta for a handful of tenants after the debounce router rollout.

leo: Link to alert: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/ingress/debounce-delta (preview)

samir: Which rollout? 1.4.2 to canary or full?

anja: Full rollout last night at 23:40 UTC — RouterRelease 1.4.2 enabled debounce_policy.default_window=3s

maria: Can you paste the config snippet?

anja: ```json
{
  "debounce_policy": {
    "default_window_ms": 3000,
    "hash_keys": ["client_id","model","prompt_fingerprint"],
    "max_coalesce": 1
  }
}
```

leo: Observed symptom: tokens not being emitted to metering stream for repeat requests within 3s -> preview undercounts.

metering-bot: metric debounced_events_total increased from ~40/s to 4k/s for sdk_version=js-2.3.1 :warning: 

samir: Is this only SDK js-2.3.1? Could be client retry behavior.

ops-oncall: We're seeing invoice preview delta of -$0.2k for tenant group alpha for window 23:40–00:20.

devex: If clients do repeated warmup pings (common with our new SDK), debounce will collapse them — maybe need whitelist of ping-type.

maria: Can we check raw ingest? sample log lines:

```
[2026-03-20T23:45:12Z] INGRESS id=abc123 tenant=alpha fingerprint=fp1 tokens=512 emit=false debounced_by=default_window
[2026-03-20T23:45:13Z] INGRESS id=abc124 tenant=alpha fingerprint=fp1 tokens=512 emit=false debounced_by=default_window
[2026-03-20T23:45:14Z] INGRESS id=abc125 tenant=alpha fingerprint=fp1 tokens=512 emit=true
```

leo: So two out of three were dropped and only last emitted — undercount.

anja: Quick mitigation options:
- rollback debounce (fast but noisy)
- add hash key include request_id or user-intent header to split warmups
- change default_window to 200ms for canary

samir: My vote: narrow window for canary and add telemetry into console: per-tenant debounced_rate, sdk_version breakdown.

devex: UX note — console preview currently shows only aggregate debounced_events; need per-route and per-tenant drilldown to surface this during rollouts.

ops-oncall: Deploying patch to canary now: set default_window_ms=200 and enable sdk-version whitelisting for alpha tenants.

maria: I'll kick off an adhoc replay of dropped events into the metering backfill pipeline for affected tenants.

leo: Add a postmortem line: "debounce default too broad for common SDK warmup pattern" and add a canary test in CI that simulates 10 warmup pings.

anja: Thanks — keep updates here. :eyes: 

metering-bot: backfill-job-234 queued for tenants [alpha]. ETA ~45m

devex: Can we also add a small note in the rollout checklist: "ensure debounce metric shows <1k/s spike per tenant" — saves a future late-night.

ops-oncall: rolling patch done to canary at 00:12 UTC. Monitoring.
